subject.title: [Bug]:  cron scheduled wake to main session is skipped (status=skipped, error="disabled"), so the main agent is never woken

question: Should cron-owned main-session systemEvent wakes bypass per-agent heartbeat scheduler omission when global heartbeats are enabled, and which linked PR should become the canonical landing path?
rationale: The bug is source-visible and documented behavior supports waking, but the active fix direction changes compatibility-sensitive per-agent heartbeat semantics and there are multiple overlapping open candidate PRs.

options.title: Require proof, then accept cron override
options.body: Choose one canonical PR or replacement that covers direct and queued cron paths, require redacted cron-run proof, and accept cron scheduling as the owner of these wakes while preserving the global disable gate.

options.title: Keep per-agent omission authoritative
options.body: Reject the current bypass direction and keep the issue open for a different fix that does not wake agents omitted from explicit heartbeat configuration.

options.title: Pause for maintainer replacement
options.body: Close or pause overlapping contributor branches only after a maintainer-owned replacement path is selected for the same issue.

recommendation.title: Require proof, then accept cron override
recommendation.body: Choose one canonical PR or replacement that covers direct and queued cron paths, require redacted cron-run proof, and accept cron scheduling as the owner of these wakes while preserving the global disable gate.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent cross-boundary history across heartbeat summary behavior and adjacent cron systemEvent delivery work.
